notes: Access: shop.vtwonen.nl reached directly via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124, robots.txt permits. Checked full collections.json (1250 collections) and pages.json (98 pages) for New Arrivals terms (nieuw, nieuwe collectie, nieuwkomers, new, arrivals) - found exactly one: /collections/nieuw-binnen ('Nieuw binnen' = 'New In'), which is also mirrored as a page handle with the same name. Confirmed genuine PLP, not pure editorial: it is a top-level main-nav item (same nav level as 'sale' and category groups), meta description reads 'Laat je inspireren door de nieuwste producten in onze collectie' (='Let yourself be inspired by the newest products in our collection'), and /collections/nieuw-binnen/products.json returns a real, normally-paginating Shopify product feed (steady 250 products/page with distinct product IDs, prices, vendors - confirmed through page 100). The rendered page (checked via Playwright after JS/Searchanise widget load) is a hybrid: an editorial 'Nieuwe collectie' hero + a 'shop per categorie' subcategory grid, PLUS an actual lazy-loaded product grid at the bottom tagged 'nieuwe collectie' on each item, confirming it functions as a real merchandising PLP layered over some editorial content (not a pure lookbook/announcement page with no listing). Recorded as a single undifferentiated New Arrivals listing (no genuine site-exposed New-Arrivals sub-categories; the 'shop per categorie' grid links out to each product's own normal category, not a New-Arrivals-scoped child collection). QTY COULD NOT BE VERIFIED EXACTLY: this collection is unusually large. Enumerating https://shop.vtwonen.nl/collections/nieuw-binnen/products.json?limit=250&page=N returned a full 250-product page all the way to page 100 (25,000 unique product IDs), then page 101 returned HTTP 400 - this is Shopify's own storefront pagination ceiling for the /products.json endpoint (results beyond page*limit=25,000 are not retrievable through this endpoint at all, regardless of true collection size), so exhaustion-to-completion (the project's normal proof method) is not possible here. The collection's products_count metafield (https://shop.vtwonen.nl/collections/nieuw-binnen.json) reports 30289, but per this project's established finding that Shopify products_count is unreliable, this number was NOT used as evidence. No 'X of Y products' or similar on-page count text was found either in the SSR HTML or in the Playwright-rendered DOM after full JS execution (the storefront's product grid/Searchanise widget does not expose a total count anywhere visible). Rather than fabricate or use the untrusted metafield, qty is recorded as null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag. Also checked Searchanise site search for 'nieuw' equivalents - not used as it only returns generic keyword matches, and the real nav-linked collection above already fully answers the discovery question.

rows.evidence: Confirmed genuine, large, real PLP (steady 250-product pages up to page 100 = 25,000 distinct product IDs via /collections/nieuw-binnen/products.json). Exact total unverifiable: page 101 of that endpoint returns HTTP 400 (Shopify's own hard pagination ceiling at 25,000 items), and no 'X of Y' total-count text is exposed anywhere in SSR or Playwright-rendered HTML. The collection's products_count metafield (30289) exists but is excluded as evidence per this project's proven-unreliable finding for that field.
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: exact qty unverifiable - genuine New Arrivals PLP has more than 25,000 products, exceeding the /products.json pagination ceiling (page 101 = HTTP 400); no reliable on-site total-count signal found to confirm the true number.
